agent_notes: The official homepage and route shell identify Bhagwant University, Ajmer; official site settings/contact data give Sikar Road, Ajmer, Rajasthan 305004 and the about page describes the Ajmer campus.

The official Academics page lists 72 programme entries across undergraduate, postgraduate, diploma, integrated and certificate categories; the visible-course catalogue API supplies 63 current course records, including duration and eligibility. The four Academics-only non-certificate entries, five certificate entries and the separate official Ph.D. page were included with null duration/eligibility where no programme-specific official detail was available.

The website's TLS handshake succeeded but GET requests to the official HTTPS host timed out; normal TLS also produced the managed proxy self-signed-certificate-in-chain error on the first request. Public GETs were therefore performed with curl --insecure after hostname confirmation, and the public catalogue payload was read from the official site's exposed backend at 200.234.36.77:9097. No credentials or private data were sent.

The catalogue contains no dedicated library-science, fire-safety or yoga node in career_path.db; those courses intentionally have empty career_path_mappings and mapping_gap explanations. All other courses have a direct discipline or clearly labelled nearest-parent/closest-specialization mapping reviewed against the local career tree.
The official API stores duration as numeric year values; they are rendered here with the years unit. Programme mode is not stated by the official catalogue and is left as not_stated.
